## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contract-level change.

## Validation

- [ ] Core Python tests pass.
- [ ] Generated examples are current when renderer output changed.
- [ ] Security and path-containment behavior remains fail-closed.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior.
- [ ] No private operational data, credentials, local paths, or generated development artifacts are included.

## Contract impact

Describe schema, capability, manifest, deterministic-output, or compatibility effects. Write
`None` when the change does not affect a machine-readable contract.
